text: Item TE27.55 entitled "Speed Hump Installation on Brock Avenue" was adopted by Toronto and East York Community Council at its meeting on September 9, 2021. An omission in the recommendations has since been discovered and require correction. As such, a re-opening and amendment of the Item TE27.55 is required. The required amendments include reducing the existing speed limit of "40 km/hr, between Croatia Street and Bloor Street West" on Brock Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item TE27.55 entitled "Speed Hump Installation on Brock Avenue". 2. Amended Item TE27.55 by adding the following new Recommendation 3: "3. Toronto and East York Community Council reduce the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Brock Avenue, between Croatia Street and Bloor Street West, in conjunction with the installation of speed humps."
